cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - DiscRack
cc:Work.dc:description:
A rack for storing disk-shaped objects vertically next to each other
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes DiscRack --sx '15*6' --disc_diameter 120 --angle 10 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes DiscRack --sx --disc_diameter --angle --reference
